description: Config for the standalone Renovate run in .github/workflows/renovate.yml. Automerge is enabled because the runner image pins explicit upstream releases (ubuntu base image, GitHub Actions runner, Azure DevOps agent) and those pins need automated bumps. No 'schedule' here on purpose: run timing is owned solely by the workflow cron, so this config never blocks an on-demand workflow_dispatch run. 'platformAutomerge' is off because GitHub's auto-merge queue only releases a PR once required checks pass, which would need branch protection; instead the workflow dispatches .github/workflows/validate-build.yml on each renovate/* branch (a bot push starts no workflow run, an explicit dispatch does) and Renovate merges once that check is green - usually on the following run. 'prHourlyLimit' is switched off from its default of 2 because that default counts every PR opened in the current clock hour and silently skips PR creation once reached; one grouped PR per run needs no rate limiting. Note: 'comment' is not a Renovate option, so annotations must live in 'description' fields.

customManagers.description: The self-hosted GitHub Actions runner is downloaded by version from the actions/runner release page rather than installed from a package repository, so no built-in manager sees it. Track the release tag directly and let Renovate rewrite the ARG.

Same as the runner above, for the Azure DevOps agent tarball. The download host (vstsagentpackage) publishes no version index, so the version is resolved from the agent's GitHub releases, which use the identical version numbers.

packageRules.description: Everything actionable lands in one branch/PR, so a run produces a single validate-build.yml dispatch and a single merge rather than one per dependency. Managers are listed explicitly instead of grouping '*': github-actions must stay out of the group because GITHUB_TOKEN cannot push under .github/workflows, and a grouped branch containing such a change would fail for every other update in it too. Combined with the top-level 'separateMajorMinor: false' this yields exactly one renovate/* branch per run.

Bump the pinned Ubuntu base image of the runner image. Held to the LTS line: the runner installs distribution packages (openjdk, mssql-tools18, docker.io) whose availability is release-specific, so a jump to a non-LTS or next-LTS release is a deliberate manual change, not an automerged one.

GitHub Actions updates are listed on the dependency dashboard instead of raising branches: GITHUB_TOKEN has no 'workflow' scope, so pushing a change under .github/workflows is rejected and the run would fail on every attempt. Tick an item on the dashboard only if you intend to apply that bump by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Disabled because the run authenticates with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN, which cannot read Dependabot alerts: that is a GitHub App 'vulnerability_alerts' permission with no matching key for the Actions token's 'permissions:' block. Leaving it enabled only produces a 'Cannot access vulnerability alerts' warning on every run. Re-enable together with a PAT that has the 'security_events' scope if alert-driven PRs are ever wanted.
